sections.heading: What Is a WhatsApp Business Solution Provider in India?

blocks.html: A WhatsApp Business Solution Provider, or BSP, is a Meta-approved company that gives businesses access to the official WhatsApp Business API — the version built for automation, not the free consumer app. Instead of applying to Meta directly and managing infrastructure yourself, a BSP handles activation, hosting and compliance, and layers a dashboard, chatbot builder and reporting on top. This is where most of the actual product difference between providers lives, whether you're a large enterprise or searching for the right WhatsApp API for a small business in India.

items.title: Official API access, managed for you:
items.desc: A BSP holds the Meta infrastructure relationship so you don't have to negotiate server hosting or API compliance on your own.

items.title: A usable dashboard on top of raw API access:
items.desc: Chatbot builders, broadcast tools and a shared inbox replace what would otherwise be direct, code-heavy API calls.

items.title: Onboarding and template approvals handled end to end:
items.desc: Business verification, number migration and message template review move faster with a BSP guiding the process.

items.title: Local support that understands Indian business hours:
items.desc: A provider based in India can troubleshoot in real time instead of routing every query through a distant time zone.

sections.heading: Why an Official Meta Business Partnership Matters

blocks.html: Not every company offering "WhatsApp automation" is actually an approved Meta Business Partner. That distinction matters more than it looks, because it affects everything downstream — how quickly your number gets verified, how reliably your messages get delivered, and what happens if Meta changes a policy overnight.

items.title: Verified access, not a workaround:
items.desc: An official partner connects through Meta's approved channels, so your account isn't built on a fragile, unofficial integration.

items.title: Faster policy and template compliance:
items.desc: Partners get earlier visibility into Meta's category and template rules, which means fewer rejected messages on your side.

items.title: Priority infrastructure access:
items.desc: Official Business Platform partners typically get earlier access to new messaging features as Meta rolls them out.

items.title: Accountability if something breaks:
items.desc: A verified partner has a direct escalation path with Meta — not just a support inbox that goes quiet when there's an outage.

blocks.html: You can confirm any provider's partner status directly on Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform page before you commit to anything.

sections.heading: Understanding WhatsApp API Pricing in India

blocks.html: Pricing confuses people because there are two separate bills. Your BSP charges a platform fee for the dashboard, chatbot builder and analytics. Meta separately charges per template message sent — and replies inside the 24-hour customer service window, which covers most day-to-day conversations, cost nothing on Meta's side. Add 18% GST, billed in INR, and that's the complete picture.

rows: Chatbot, broadcast tools, team inbox, analytics
Monthly or annual plan, in INR
API activation, flow design, template approvals
GST on platform and message charges
18%, with GST invoice on every payment

items.title: Judge cost per lead, not per message:
items.desc: A plan that looks slightly more expensive up front is often cheaper overall once you factor in what it saves on missed enquiries. Ask any provider for a plain rate card before you commit.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions: WhatsApp Business API Provider in India

items.q: How much does WhatsApp Business API cost in India?
items.a: There's a platform subscription for the dashboard and chatbot, plus Meta's per-message charges for templates you send. Replies inside the 24-hour service window are free. 18% GST applies, billed in INR, with a plain rate card shared upfront.

items.q: Do I need a BSP to use the WhatsApp Business API?
items.a: Not strictly — Meta allows self-managed access through its direct Cloud API. Most businesses still prefer a BSP for the dashboard, chatbot builder, onboarding help and local support that come bundled in.

items.q: WhatsApp Business API vs Meta Cloud API — which should I choose?
items.a: The Cloud API suits teams with in-house developers willing to manage infrastructure directly. A BSP suits businesses that want a ready dashboard, chatbot builder and support team without building all of that themselves.

items.q: Is the WhatsApp Business API free or paid?
items.a: It's paid. Meta charges per template message by category, though service replies within the 24-hour customer window are free. Your BSP separately charges a platform fee for the dashboard and tools.

items.q: How long does WhatsApp Business API verification take?
items.a: With a BSP guiding the process, most businesses complete Meta business verification and go live within 48 hours. Self-managed applications through Meta directly can take considerably longer.

items.q: Can I integrate the WhatsApp API with my existing CRM?
items.a: Yes. Contact details, conversation history and lead status can sync automatically to Zoho, HubSpot, Salesforce or a custom system through connectors and open APIs.

items.q: Which WhatsApp API provider offers the best support in India?
items.a: Look for a provider with an India-based team available during Indian business hours rather than a ticket queue routed overseas. Ojiva AI offers direct support, Monday–Saturday, IST.
